post.title: ISO Graphic Designer (NO AI!) for my face painting business.
post.body:
I did this design myself and it took me almost 4 hours just on chalkboard 😭 and I still need to do business cards and everything!
I’d like a more simplistic version of this that captures that Day of The Dead look I’m going for but make it cute enough to still bring customers to my booth. I ask that you put more emphasis on the mascots, my black lab and brindle treeing dog. Please lmk your rates, thank you so much!

analysis.summary: A graphic designer is needed to create a simplified, cute Day of the Dead style logo featuring two dogs for a face painting business.
analysis.applyInstructions: Please lmk your rates, thank you so much!

expect: does not invent a price list or package price; any rate comes from the profile or is left to discuss
respects the 'no AI' request and does not offer AI-generated work
mentions the Day of the Dead look, the two dog mascots and the business cards, and is honest that the work shown is a student project
